title: What a Dutch invoice states
source: Wet op de omzetbelasting 1968 as in force on 1 January 2026: art. 35a lid 1 (a the date, b a sequential number, c the supplier's btw-identificatienummer, d the customer's for a reverse charge or an intra-EU supply, e both parties' full names and addresses, f quantity and kind, g the date of supply, h the amount per rate and the unit price, i the rate, j the VAT, m the mention «btw verlegd»), lid 4 (the VAT in euro) and art. 34f (a document that changes an invoice refers to it specifically and unambiguously). Handelsregisterwet 2007 art. 27 lid 1: the KvK number on outgoing letters, orders, invoices and offers. Peppol NL-R-001 to NL-R-009 (cited) for the same in the UBL. Read 2026-10-09.
note: Unproved: the article mapping in these rules was not proved against the official text in the 2026-10-20 standards audit.

rules.text: The number and date, the supplier's btw-id (NL, nine digits, B, two digits) and eight-digit KvK number, both parties' names and addresses, each line's unit price, the VAT per rate, «btw verlegd» with the customer's btw-id for a reverse charge and the invoice a credit note refers to, on the page; in the UBL the KvK number under scheme 0106.
